svg.title: Package manager benchmarks · Cold install
svg.desc: median install times for bun 1.4.2, pnpm12 12.6.0, upm dist-cafc69b-dirty, aube 2.2.4, deno 2.9.6, pnpm11 11.27.1, nub 0.9.3, yarn4 4.18.0, yarn1 1.22.22, npm 12.0.2; fixtures: nitro, nuxt, next. Median install time · lower is better · ranked by overall score. 90 timed runs. Shapes identify projects; exact values are in marker tooltips. Managers with a clean time in every case are ranked by score, the geometric mean of their time over the best ranked time per run and project; the rest follow as unranked. Logos next to manager names show what each runs on; the size under a version is the manager itself on disk. Overlapping markers are separated vertically without changing their time.
